title: Cobblemon Fierce Competition - Extras
description: Stuff that didn't quite fit in the original datapack
body:
# Fierce Competition: Extras
### Requires [Fierce Competition](https://modrinth.com/datapack/cbmn-fierce)
![Divider - 4x res](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7e63fac2b0ce3f1778f0ac07443c0fbaebf7f330.png)
Heyo! I made this as some sort of cluster hivemind mega cloud server data center (?) place to upload things that would be cool for some people but are simply not for everyone.
Its a nice little way to make everyone happy-ish with the project's (eventually) final outcome

That's about it! Hope you guys enjoy!
